notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Stun Lock Fix & Disorientation Nerf
notes.content:
A quick patch that addresses some pain points among the new enemies. More significant level balancings & bug fixes coming soon! 

If you encounter any bugs while playing, please [b]report them to me on [url="https://discord.gg/h87PpApxje"]Discord[/url][/b]! 

-------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]If Odin gets [b]repeatedly stunned[/b], his stun duration is cut short by increasing amounts each time 
[list][*][i]I always thought of stun-locking as a rare & funny thing, but raged-up Captain Phantoms have [url="https://youtu.be/Ub9eJhlnZcs?si=kCsA5GapXBb0Ei-b]claimed too many octopus lives[/url], and made Level 3-14 nightmarish for those who don't possess the necessary techniques. Being stun-locked for an extended period of time doesn't feel fair to players either, so I am now preventing it from occurring. A raged Captain should only get 2 hits on you now, if you make an attempt to run away![/i][/list][/list]
[list]
[*]When Odin is [b]hit by a Boomerang while already disoriented[/b], the new Boomerang hit will now increase the remaining disorientation duration by 33% (capped at the original full duration), rather than always resetting the disorientation duration back to full 
[*]When Odin gets [b]damaged while disoriented[/b], the disorientation duration now decreases based on the amount of damage taken 
[list][*][i]The disorientation status effect has revealed to me the duality of men: To some, it's a mere inconvenience, while to others, getting disoriented is almost a guaranteed game loss. I am adding quite a bit of anti-snowballing to when a player is performing poorly under disorientation: Getting chained by boomerangs will no longer lock you into the status effect for as long; If you fail to dodge incoming damage while disoriented, you'll also recover from the stupor faster, and become able to escape out of potentially game-ending positions.[/i][/list][/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
(I am aware of several other issues you guys have reported - I will aim to fix them soon!) 

[list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where if you exited the Graveyard without saving the skeletons you placed inside a Grave, you would [b]lose these skeletons[/b]
[list][*][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1416659325111238740/1416659325111238740"]Reported[/url] by Aeon[/list][/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where upon reloading a Graveyard region, then opening a Charge Station that is already charging, you can [b]insert a battery even if you had none[/b]
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1417602160341815357/1417602160341815357"]Reported[/url] by Darthen[/i][/list][/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where if a [b]Spiky Urchin got stunned while rolling[/b], its rolling loop audio continues playing 
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1417645412516630678/1417645412516630678"]Reported[/url] by Darthen[/i][/list][/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where [b]tutorial panels went missing[/b] in Levels 2-7, 2-8, and 2-9
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1418165440621973565/1418165440621973565"]Reported[/url] by projectmoonbrainrot[/i][/list]
[/list][list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where [b]Boss Fight anti-snowballing[/b] counts Turret Clams towards your number of combat turrets
[/list][list][*][i]If some boss fights dragged on for too long, this was why. I somehow never noticed this oversight until now.[/i][/list]

[h1]Misc Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added a pop-up message for when you try to enter Volcanic Ridge
[*]Added decorations to later Twilight Zone levels 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Operation Octo
notes.content:
Time for the post-release Patch :D

(Full disclosure: It normally takes me a month to make a boss fight, but I had to make the Twilight Zone boss in 3 days. He needs A LOT of tweaking right now, and I intend to majorly rework him in the next few days!)

If you encounter any bugs while playing, please [b]report them to me on [url="https://discord.gg/h87PpApxje"]Discord[/url][/b]! 

-------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
(I am aware of several other issues you guys have reported - I will aim to fix them soon!) 

[h2]Gameplay Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where [b]Imitation Crab[/b] cannot transform into a Bubble Parrot 
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1415751920080912506/1415751920080912506"]Reported[/url] by Lavauk[/i][/list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where [b]Watchdog[/b]'s cost isn't capped at 60 pearls
[/list]

[h2]Achievement Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]"Salty Seadog"[/b] achievement can no longer be acquired by not exiting a finished level
[*]Fixed a glitch where [b]"Salty Seadog"[/b] achievement fails to unlock 
[*]Fixed a glitch where [b]"Archeologist"[/b] achievement does not unlock
[*]Fixed a glitch where [b]"Bountiful Harvest"[/b] achievement does not unlock
[*]Fixed a glitch where [b]"Break Time"[/b] achievement could be unlocked by stunning a Diver that's not drilling (but had reached max charge before)
[/list]

[h2]Visual Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed [b]Twilight Zone vision shader[/b] issues on Linux / Steam Deck, when not running through Proton 
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1415707047302922471/1415707047302922471"]Reported[/url] by Natlove[/i][/list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where the [b]"Bottled Hollow"[/b] shop item is displayed as a Mutant Elixir instead 
[/list]

[h2]Misc Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where players could get stuck after [b]Level 3-10[/b]'s second-last wave 
[/list]

[h1]Misc Changes[/h1]
[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]"Photomania"[/b] achievement now requires 15 on-field Lantern Fish, instead of 10 
[/list]

[h2]Level Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Repositioned [b]Level 3-10[/b] Clam locations
[*]Reduced [b]Level 3-10[/b] enemies spawns later on
[list][*][i]While 3-10 has been the highlight of many people's playthroughs, I've also heard many say it is far too overwhelming. I'm tuning down the number of skeletons that interfere with the player. The Clams have been repositioned to prevent certain optimal strategies.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]SPOILERS[/b]
[*][b]Dr. Kraxen[/b] will now hop towards the player at the start of his final phase
[list][*][i]This is due to a [url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1416038614869213264/1416038614869213264"]bug report[/url] by TrulyAzul - Dr. Kraxen normally clears all the boulders near you at the start of phase 2, and I am apply this to phase 3 as well, in case any player got trapped.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*]Some [b]Twilight Zone Boss[/b] reworks
[list][*][i]People are saying he's a lot more fun to fight now after the patch. I did some preliminary balancings - Will make him better yet in a day or two![/i][/list]
[/list]

[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added more Twilight Zone [b]Treat Bucket tips[/b]
[*]Added some [b]alternate dialogues[/b] 
[/list]

notes.title: Operation Octo is Released!
notes.content:
[i]Operation Octo[/i] has just released! You can now play up until the first 3 biomes! 
It has been 5 years since I started making this game - Thank you all so much for being part of the journey <3

If you encounter any bugs while playing, please [b]report them to me on [url="https://discord.gg/h87PpApxje"]Discord[/url][/b]! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356379/71fafd2e47e182beedffa80753e8c02ecbbfeca4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356379/480f0afb416228b9bf5421b0206316559c844095.png[/img][/url]

-------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Looking Ahead[/h1]

[list]
[*]I will immediately be working on [b]new gadgets[/b], [b]new shop turrets[/b], and lots of [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] & [b]balancing[/b] in the next few weeks! 
[*]More biomes, starting with [b]Volcanic Ridge[/b], will eventually be added as [b]free updates[/b] 
[*]But before that, expect the [b]level editor[/b] to arrive this year, where you can create & share custom levels via Steam Workshop! 
[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Other Noteable Changes[/h1]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Bolt Eel[/b] cost decreased from 50 to 45 
[list][*][i]Eels have consistently been the weakest combat turret, due to its weakness in early game, and levels never spawning too many enemies for AoE investments to pay off. A slight cost decrease will alleviate some of the early-game struggles Eel deck experience.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Bubble Parrot[/b] deployment time (turret ball toss) reduced from 1 second to 0.3 second 
[list][*][i]You now have reasons to reactively revive turrets in a timely manner. This deployment speed buff will make Parrots more reliable for these use cases later on.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Mutant Bumper Fish[/b] melee damage deflection increased from 50% to 66%
[list][*][i]Mutant Elixirs are so precious, that people rarely give it to a Bumper, whom I actually consider to have a very interesting upgrade.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Lionfish[/b] spike damage to 4 targets increased from 30 to 35
[list][*][i]Lionfish is often thought of as the weakest gadget, due to it requiring very niche scenarios to be worthwhile. If you barely failed to snipe a single skeleton with Lionfish, you'll now still get a bit of a bonus for the placement.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*]Pleco [b]attract capacity[/b] per collection decreased from 4 items to 1 item 
[*]Pleco [b]collection cooldown[/b] decreased from 7 seconds to 4 seconds
[*]Pleco now picks up the item that is closest to it, while prioritizing pearls inside Clams 
[*]Mutant Pleco[b]attract capacity[/b] per collection decreased from 8 items to 2 items 
[*]Mutant Pleco[b]collection cooldown[/b] decreased from 4 seconds to 2 seconds
[list][*][i]Pleco, the most OP turret in the game, is finally getting nerfed! This rework is mainly aimed at reducing Pleco's synergy with Pearl Tree. Pleco will now require a whopping 16 seconds to fully reel in a Pearl Tree's produce! (assuming there aren't other pickups that're also waiting to be collected!) If you bring Pearl Tree to a battle, Pleco is no longer your default choice of collector, and you might now want to manually tend to each Pearl Tree harvest.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Pearl Tree[/b] now attracts skeletons that are close to it (Forcing attacks similar to what Red Herring does)
[list][*][i]It's too easy to profit off of Pearl Trees. There simply wasn't enough of a risk to this economy investment. Now, if even an otherwise-harmless Bandana Skeleton waddles through your base, your Pearl Tree could die.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Hammer Shark[/b] can no longer demolish a Pearl Tree while it is bursting pearls 
[*][b]Hammer Shark[/b] Hammer Shark can no longer demolish Clams 
[list][*][i]Recycling Clams has led to some game-breaking (but hilarious) shenanigans. Check out [url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1405818339174912051/1405818339174912051"]Eagle's Clamless strat[/url]. Hammering Clams demolishes how this game's meant to be played, and I have finally resolved to ban the option instead of trying to nerf it more.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Watchdog[/b] cost now capped at 60 
[list][*][i]Watchdog will no longer become a guaranteed stuck-in-your-hand card. This should give it more flexibility, and allow it to not be a "total" dead-weight to Imitation Crab decks. (I just found out that the price cap isn't working for now - Will patch it tomorrow!)[/i][/list]
[/list]

notes.title: v0.9 Update - Gadgets for Sandy Shallows!
notes.content:
[i]Operation Octo[/i] is at 2000 wishlists now, thanks to [url="youtube.com/@Creeps20"]Creeps20[/url]'s [url="youtube.com/watch?v=LQsNuaSss10"]video essay[/url] on the game! 
[i](I really thought the game wouldn't even sell 10 copies in the past - Thank you all for believing in this project!)[/i]

I've got a big round of content upgrades for the demo this time - You can play around with most of them right away :) 

If you encounter any bugs while playing, please [b]report them to me on [url="https://discord.gg/h87PpApxje"]Discord[/url][/b]! 

-------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Introducing... Gadgets![/h1]

[b]Gadgets[/b] are a [b]brand new feature[/b] that lets you shift the tides of battles! 
They act like Dr. Odin's [i]abilities[/i] that can be activated [i]for free[/i], but have a [i]cooldown[/i] between uses: 

[h2]Spiky Urchin[/h2]
[list]
[*][i][b]Moves towards nearby skeletons and fights them with spikes[/b][/i]
[*]Unlocked after [b]Level 1-2[/b]!
[*]A simple & hands-off tank that holds off early enemies
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356379/a10b0c4ad4a6d0196a8f87815762e35ac7731698.png[/img]


[h2]Red Herring[/h2]
[list]
[*][i][b]Forces nearby skeletons to walk towards and attack it[/b][/i]
[*]Unlocked after [b]Level 1-4[/b]
[*]Perfect for kiting skeletons to where you want 'em, and even pulling skeleton off of turrets they've locked on
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356379/8ae9e587c4ce4bcc8ae6ea3489ea8d17ab25b07c.png[/img]


[h2]Imitation Crab[/h2]
[list]
[*][i][b]Temporarily turns into the first turret on your conveyor[/b](i.e. Sushi Belt)[/i]
[*]Becomes available in the shop after [b]Level 1-6[/b], to be bought for 10 Coins
[*]Good for heavy decks - Gets value out of that one expensive turret that's been stuck in your hand
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356379/3d19cfa3500afc89b6a78a0c2539bc8cba96166d.png[/img]


[h2]Lionfish[/h2]
[list]
[*][i][b]Shoots out 5 spikes to be distributed between all skeletons in an area[/b][/i]
[*]Unlocked after [b]Level 1-9[/b]
[*]An insta that wrecks a skeleton if it's singled out, but accomplishes little if dropped onto a larger group of skeletons
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44356379/53d2bbae27cfc9e7d0a7ff95e548ce08ee6bbdc8.png[/img]


-------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Other Noteable Changes[/h1]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Crâne Exalté[/b] (1st World Boss)'s [b]Orb damage[/b] to turrets increased by 50% (Damage to Odin remains unchanged)
[*]Crâne Exalté's "Ring Around" move [b]maximum reach[/b] slightly increased 
[*]Slightly reduced [b]Blobfish's spawn chance[/b] during Crâne Exalté's 3rd phase 
[list][*][i]The 1st Boss had been over-nerfed over the past 2 years. I want the Boss's mass AoE attacks to become bigger threats to turrets. This was a boss fight where the player became more-or-less completely safe once a stable field of turrets had been established - This Orb damage buff will allow the Boss to frequently disrupt your existing turret formation, prompting the player to more actively engage with the ever-shifting tides, even later on into the Boss fight.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[h2]Misc Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reversed [b]camera zoom controls[/b] on controllers 
[list][*][i]Only applicable to contents beyond the demo; 
This is for a consistency where the right-side buttons are for initiating actions (Zooming Out / Selecting), while the left-side buttons are for undoing actions (Zooming In / Cancelling)[/i][/list]
[*]Removed [b]Metal Detector[/b] from the shop (You now automatically unlock Coin-Drops when you unlock the shop)
[list][*][i]This is to avoid cluttering the shop after the addition of Imitation Crab; 
You will be refunded Metal Detector's purchase cost if you've already bought it [/i][/list]
[*]Added a dev console command [b]/ToggleRegen[/b], which lets you turn off Odin's HP regen for this play session 
[list][*][i]Made for the try-hards who want to do permanent-damage runs ;)[/i][/list]
[*]Increased enemy spawns in [b]Level 1-5 (Bumper Maze)[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where Bumper Fish could bump Odin into the walls 
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1399529684223529080/1399529684223529080"]Reported[/url] by Ruben[/i][/list]
[*]Improved handling of corrupted save files
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1397576934950437048/1397576934950437048"]Reported[/url] by untitleduser4[/i][/list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where a Racquet Skeleton could walk around at sonic speed while deflecting all projectiles, until it attacks something 
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1402134843017400411/1402134843017400411"]Reported[/url] by LameGamerTime[/i][/list]
[*]Fixed a glitch where a cannonball could damage a neighboring turret as it gets deflected under rare circumstances
[list][*][i][url="https://discord.com/channels/1126367010067066941/1397584623306932416/1397584623306932416"]Reported[/url] by LameGamerTime[/i][/list]
[*]Attempted fix of Steam Cloud Save issues for Mac
[list][*][i][b]If you play this game on Mac[/b], please let me know whether your Cloud Save is functional![/i][/list]
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8 Update - Blobby & Bumper Reworks!
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all for playing [i]Operation Octo[/i] during the Next Fest! I have watched many playthrough videos, and have cooked up some major reworks to the early economy as well as turrets - Hope these will help improve a new player's experience! 

If you encounter any bugs while playing, please [b]report them to me on [url="https://discord.gg/h87PpApxje"]Discord[/url][/b]! 

[/p][h1]Demo Changes[/h1][h2]Turret Rework - Blobfish[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Blobfish cost[/b] increased from 40 to 60 pearls	[/p][/*][*][p] Blobfish now [b]gives a Large Pearl (worth 15 pearls)[/b] for every enemy it kills[/p][/*][*][p] Blobfish's explosion has been splitted into [b]two less damaging explosions[/b] w/ a slight pause in between (total damage unchanged) [/p][/*][*][p] Blobfish is now immune to all status effects  [/p][/*][*][p] Added a flavor text onto the explosion VFX when Blobfish managed to earn back its cost [/p][/*][/list][p][i]Blobfish has always been the least viable (yet most destructive) turret, which renders him a major noob trap (He is the second unlock!) I'd allowed Blobfish to remain in its broken state thus far, because most playtesters quickly figured out that Blobfish are to be used sparingly. With the massive influx of new players from the Next Festival, however, I've seen too many new players spam Blobfish (and rarely build persistent turrets) - The levels become unplayable for them as a result. Having an early turret which players need to actively be taught to NOT use is far from ideal - Besides, "actively engaging the enemies by throwing bombs that them" is a desirable player behaviour in my books. It is time for a major Blobby revamp. 

What's the simplest way to make people "build more Shrimps & less Blobs"? George Fan taught PvZ players to build Sunflowers via a simple human tendency: Whichever button lights up more often is the one people will constantly want to click on (This fact has never been more clearly demonstrated to me than during the Festival). Because OO does not have build cooldowns on turrets, Blobfish's cost will have to be increased above Pistol Shrimp's (in order to have Shrimp's build option light up more frequently). 

To prevent Blobby from becoming ultra-F-tier (and ruin the run for anyone who still dareth deploy him), some compensations are in order. Years ago, my mentor had suggested that Blobfish should produce pearls on enemy kills. I was reluctant about introducing too much complexity early on, and disliked the fact that unlike all pearl producers in OO, Blobfish does not look mollusk-like. However, watching (a small percentage of) players' painstaking struggles has finally convinced me to take the leap. In the past, Blobfish had acted as a means of comeback "at a permanent cost". Now, players with weak lines of defense will be making serious bucks out of the enemies overrunning their base, while skilled players can also spot "profit opportunities" for timely Blobfish drops. Blobfish is now an interesting economy option that can more reliably act as a secondary source-of-damage. 

And hopefully, all this will incentivize new players to save Blobfish for large enemy swarms (instead of dropping him on a single already-dying enemy like sooo many people do). [/i]

[/p][h2]Turret Rework - Bumper Fish[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Bumper Fish[/b] no longer blocks Odin from moving through it  [/p][/*][*][p] Bumper Fish now [b]bumps Odin out of itself[/b] if Odin either stopped inside of it, or spent longer than 0.4 seconds moving through it  [/p][/*][*][p] Bumper Fish [b]shakes[/b] as to indicate how close it is to bumping Odin 	[/p][/*][*][p] Slightly increased Bumper Fish's [b]hurtbox size[/b] (which is also used for blocking & deflecting)	[/p][/*][*][p] Slightly lowered Bumper Fish's hurtbox [/p][/*][/list][p][i]One of the most common complaints from the Next Fest players was the fact that Bumper Fish "had collision", while other turrets didn't (Many players thought some turrets were "randomly" blocking their movement). The reasoning behind Bumper Fish's collider was to prevent the player from hiding inside a Bumper indefinitely (else he'd be completely immune to all projectiles). I never liked the inconsistency with movement blocking either. During OO's conception, I had intended for Bumper Fish to bump the player away upon contact, as to communicate the fact that you cannot hide inside this specific turret type. I thought accidental bumpings would feel too obnoxious, and gave Bumper a static collider instead.   I am now bringing back the original "bumping" concept, but tuning it way down. The player will now be able to pass through Bumper Fish like it was any other turret. But, if the player made an attempt to stay inside a Bumper, he would be bumped out quickly, by no more distance than is necessary. I hope the new bumping behavior will accomplish the intended purpose in a natural & well-communicated way, without feeling obtrusive to those playing the game normally. This change may take away some of the satisfaction of ducking around then behind a Bumper to deflect a pursuing missile, but I think the trade-offs are worthwhile. [/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Other Balance Changes[/h2][list][*][p] When [b]Crâne Exalté[/b] slams down to launch orbs, it now deals damage to turrets placed immediately next to it[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Early Economy Rework[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Shop[/b] now unlocks after level 1-6 (Originally unlocked after 1-10)    [/p][/*][*][p] Added a [b]Metal Detector[/b] shop item - Upon purchase, unlocks random coin-drops from defeated skeletons     [/p][/*][*][p] [b]Bubble Parrot[/b] & [b]Pleco-llector[/b] shop buying price increased from 30 to 50 coins    [/p][/*][*][p] [b]Treat Bucket[/b] now enters the shop after level 1-7    [/p][/*][*][p] [b]Treat Bucket[/b] quests priority re-arranged, fish requirements adjusted  [/p][/*][*][p] Sandy Shallows levels [b]coin reward & drop-rates[/b] adjusted [/p][/*][/list][p][i]This is the beginning of a larger round of adjustments to the game's early economy. A glaring current issue with the economy is that players have nothing to spend coins on for a significant stretch of the game (while a reliable economy sink isn't introduced until Twilight Zone). Players can now start earning coins and interact with the Shop much earlier on. After the number adjustments, people should be able to buy off Bubble Parrot & Pleco at roughly the same time as before (while anticipating the purchase far in advance). [/i][/p][p][i]Moreover, the "Treat Bucket" will give players more things to do inbetween early levels.   More early purchasing options will be added in the future! (starting with extra optional turret slots, "gemium" turrets, and unlockable Odin abilities - Probably after the full release though)[/i]

[/p][h2]Misc Changes[/h2][list][*][p] Added [b]Dr. Finn animations & sound effects[/b]  [/p][/*][*][p] Reworked enemy terrain preference logic during pathfinding  [/p][/*][*][p] Reworked how a random-drop item determines the position where it lands     [/p][/*][*][p] Star VFX displayed above knocked-out turrets are now placed lower  [/p][/*][*][p] Added feedback texts for when attempting to drop turrets onto already-occupied tiles / terrain tiles  [/p][/*][*][p] Added light beams behind end-of-level rewards [/p][list][*][p] Suggestion by [url="youtube.com/@Creeps20"]Creeps20[/url] to make rewards easier to spot[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] Demo info window will only pop-up when exiting back to main menu [/p][list][*][p] [i]Idea by [url="youtube.com/@RenegadeCactus"]Renegade Cactus[/url] - I've gotten enough wishlists now, I'll stop bugging demo players inbetween levels XD[/i]	[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] Reworked pop-up tutorial messages for "Use Blobfish sparingly" and "Place ranged turrets far from skeletons"  [/p][/*][*][p] Adjusted Clam spawn timings for Level 1-6  [/p][/*][*][p] Changed victory screen text fonts & positions[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed a glitch where by rapidly skipping dialogue texts, newer texts can gradually grow larger  [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a glitch where tutorial messages can still display after the player has won / failed a level  [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a glitch where Frosty Clam does not accurately lob large pearls onto its surrounding ground tiles  [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a glitch where Pleco does not cause Turret Clam to close up as soon as its card has been collected  [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a shader issue where decor object sprites get cut off at mesh borders [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] -------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][h1]Changes to Later Biomes[/h1][p][/p][p][i][u]Spoilers ahead! The sections below are meant for people who have early access to contents beyond the demo.[/u][/i]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Zappy Jelly[/b] cost reduced from 20 to 15 [/p][list][*][p] [i]Now that Blobfish serves its own unique role, I can finally balance Zappy in a vacuum![/i]	
	[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] [b]Hollow Clam[/b] changes: [list][*][p] is [b]no longer stealthed[/b] by default[/p][/*][*][p] now [b]becomes stealthed for 5 seconds[/b] after taking any damage that could be shared with Odin [/p][/*][*][p] is now [b]immune to most adverse status effects[/b] [/p][/*][*][p] [i]A few players who got early access to Twilight Zone have convinced me that Hollow Clam is game-breaking. Giving stealth to "outlier" Clams allows you to circumvent the map design, and neglect entire chokepoints consequence-free. This enables players to concentrate all their turrets at one chosen spot, creating an unbreakable "death ball". Upgrading to Hollow Clam already comes at a huge cost to your "offensive momentum" (to borrow Creeps' terminology) - "Fixing" Hollow Clam by making it unaffordably expensive would not be ideal. [/i][/p][/*][*][p][i] I liked the "temporary stealth" idea suggested by the PvZ YouTuber [url="youtube.com/@Creeps20"]Creeps20[/url], which is aimed towards reducing the benefit of stealthing a Clam instead. Now, if you "give up" on defending a Clam by turning it Hollow, said Clam is not truly invincible, and could interrupt your regen at inopportune times. Certain enemies (especially ranged ones) can even repeatedly poke at the same Clam every time it de-stealthes, unless there are turrets nearby for them to lock onto.[/i][/p][/*][/list]	[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Hollow Bumper Fish[/b] changes: [list][*][p] is [b]no longer stealthed[/b] by default[/p][/*][*][p] now [b]becomes stealthed for 3 seconds[/b] after taking any damage [/p][/*][*][p] now [b]regens[/b] for 20 HP per second (out of its max HP of 230)[/p][/*][*][p] is now [b]immune to most adverse status effects[/b] [/p][/*][*][p] [b]does not bump away Odin[/b] if Odin hid inside it [/p][/*][*][p] [i]With the introduction of temporary stealth, Hollow Bumper can break free from feeling like a downgrade from regular Bumpers. Hollow Bumper will essentially remain a (mostly) invulnerable deflector, while retaining his ability to attract cannon fire as long as he is not threatened by non-deflectable attacks.[/i][/p][/*][/list]	[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Hollow Death Ray[/b] now receives 4 seconds worth of charge (instead of a full charge) for each knocked-out turret  [/p][list][*][p] [i]Hollow Death Ray had unstoppable synergy with the already-strong cycle decks. I wish to tune down Hollow Ray's special trait to a manageable, but still powerful level. [/i]	[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] When using [b]Hammer Shark[/b] to demolish a Clam, said Clam's remaining HP will now deal a significant amount of shared damage to Odin (Shared damage cannot kill Odin) [/p][list][*][p] [i]While it is undesirable to demolish Clams early on (which leads to a major economic deficit), demolishing Clams right before the final wave felt like too broken of a move - Doing so would remove significant late-game threats to Odin (i.e. the shared damage from inadequately-defended Clams). I am adding a risk to the trade-off - Removing Clams during late-game now causes you to start the final wave with less HP. [/i]	[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] [b]Diver Skeleton[/b] now has a strong preference towards lake tiles during pathfinding  [/p][p] 	[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Leaky Dropship[/b] now creates acid tiles under neighboring turrets while it is not moving [/p][list][*][p] [i]A Dropship whose path has been blocked by turrets will no longer be completely harmless, and will eventually break down the turrets in its way.[/i]	[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] [b]Tangler Skeleton[/b]'s total tangled turret cost calculation now caps each individual turret's price at 100[/p][list][*][p] [i]There is an upper limit to what total cost of turrets a Tangler can paralyze at once. Death Ray will pose less of a limit to Tangler's tangling capacity now.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Economy Changes[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Battery[/b] shop buying price decreased from 15 to 10 coins  [/p][/*][*][p] [b]Charge Station Pod[/b] shop buying price now starts at 2 rubies, then increases with each purchase (would eventually increase by 10s) [/p][list][*][p] [i]A sink for your late-game rubies ;)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed a glitch where Diver Skeleton could not jump out of / into lakes via a diagonal movement between tiles [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a glitch where Captain Phantom's first attack could fail to land on a turret right underneath the hammer, if Captain Phantom himself was on top of a different turret [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a glitch where if Captain Phantom was stunned during his spawn animation, he'd immediately turn ghostly at the end of the spawn animation, without appearing translucent     [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a glitch in Level 3-4, where a Dropship could be force spawned onto an unsuitable tile where it'd become stuck from the beginning  [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a glitch where Graveyard timer texts display missing characters for some localizations 
[/p][/*][/list][/p]

notes.title: Demo v0.3 Minor Update
notes.content:
[p]A minor update that makes failing at dodging a lot less punishing (and makes it easier to notice high-danger projectiles during a chaotic level), based on what I've seen players who only play Tower Defense struggle with later on in this game. 

Also did significant reworks on AoE projectiles as well as enemy pathfinding, based on bugs that I've been told about. 

If you encountered bugs during your playthrough, please [b]report them to me on [url="https://discord.gg/h87PpApxje"]Discord[/url][/b]! Many thanks :) 

[/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Boss[/b] now has a limit to how many minions can be spawned onto the field at the same time [/p][/*][*][p] [b]Boss sphere[/b] damage to player reduced by 33% [/p][/*][*][p] [b]Missile[/b] damage to player reduced by 15% [/p][/*][*][p] Upgrading to [b]Frosty Bumperfish[/b] now increases Bumper health by 74% instead of 48%[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Visual / Audio Changes[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Missile Skeleton[/b] now flashes a noticeable light when launching its missile [/p][/*][*][p] [b]Missiles[/b] now play a [b]looping sound[/b] when present, similar to Bomb Barrels [/p][/*][*][p] Boss now plays a big particle effect when dying [/p][/*][*][p] Added hit particles for [b]cannonballs[/b] and [b]Boss spheres[/b] [/p][/*][*][p] Added coin collect sound when outside of levels [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Level Changes[/h2][list][*][p] Some tutorial reworks [/p][/*][*][p] Reduced Level [b]1-13[/b] skeleton spawn immediately before first big wave [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed a glitch where if a [b]Turret Clam[/b] was hosting a turret card when it got knocked out, it will become able to spawn another turret card after waking up, even if the previous card was not collected 
[/p][/*][*][p] Reworked [b]AoE projectile[/b] behaviour so that if you stay inside of one, it always damages you at a fixed interval 
[list][*][p] [i](e.g. If you remain inside a Boss sphere, the first damage tick occurs the moment you make contact with it, while a second damage tick will not happen until exactly 1 second later; Prior to this update, the second damage tick might have come sooner depending on the sphere's life time)[/i] [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p] Reworked pathfinding so that ranged enemies are better at finding the nearest tile from which it can shoot at its target 
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed glitch where if Missile Skeleton is unable to reach player due to turrets blocking all available paths, it will stay still near a mountain tile that's deemed close to the player 
[list][*][p] [i](It now walks towards turrets instead)[/i] [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p] Attempted fix for a rare glitch where Bomb Barrels can run out of map bounds for specific players 
[/p][/*][/list]
